caption:
The library lights are dimmed, but the heat between us is just starting to rise... 🔥 There’s something about the silence of the archives at 9 PM that makes every heartbeat feel like a drum. My students usually see me as the strict professor, the one with the sharp critiques and the impeccable notes. But tonight, it’s just us in the back corner of the research wing. 📚✨

I leaned over his desk, my silk blouse straining slightly as I pointed out a 'mistake' in his thesis. I could see his breath hitch. I loved the way his eyes lingered on my lips, then traveled down to where my skirt hugged every curve. I let my hand rest a second too long on his shoulder, my fingers tracing the line of his neck. 

"You're overthinking it," I whispered, my voice barely audible over the low hum of the HVAC system. "Sometimes, the best way to learn is to... feel the pulse of the theory." 

I felt the electricity crackle between us. The air was thick with the scent of old paper and a growing, undeniable tension. My heart was racing against my ribs, but I didn't pull away. Instead, I moved closer, the soft fabric of my skirt brushing against his chair. In this secret sanctuary of knowledge, we were rewriting the rules of the syllabus. Tonight, the lesson isn't in the books—it's in the way our shadows merge against the mahogany shelves. 🤫🔥
